aids.description_en: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year for farmer families, paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank accounts. Over 110 million farmer families enrolled (2025). Aadhaar-linked DBT transfer.

aids.nom: PM Awas Yojana — Urban Housing Subsidy (PMAY-U)
aids.description_en: One-time housing subsidy up to ₹2,67,000 under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) for EWS/LIG households buying or constructing urban homes. Interest subsidy of 6.5% on housing loan for 20 years for EWS/LIG category.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

aids.nom: PM Jan Dhan Yojana — Financial Inclusion & Overdraft
aids.description_en: Zero-balance bank account with accident insurance ₹2 lakh and life insurance ₹30,000 for new enrollees. Overdraft facility up to ₹10,000 for account holders active for 6 months. 530 million accounts opened as of 2025.

Free health insurance up to ₹5 lakh per family per year covering secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at 25,000+ empanelled hospitals. No premium required. Covers 107.4 million families from the bottom 40% of population based on SECC data.

aids.nom: MGNREGA — Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee
aids.description_en: Legal guarantee of 100 days of unskilled manual employment per household per financial year in rural areas. 2025 wage rates: ₹267/day (Bihar), ₹357/day (Haryana), ₹322/day (Punjab). Payment within 15 days of work completion.

aids.nom: PM Ujjwala Yojana — Free LPG Connection & Subsidy
aids.description_en: Free LPG connection for BPL women plus subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder. Scheme 2.0 extended to migrants without permanent address. Over 100 million connections issued. Aims to replace biomass cookfuels for health and environment.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas / IOCL / BPCL / HPCL

aids.nom: NSAP — Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
aids.description_en: Monthly pension under National Social Assistance Programme: ₹200/month for age 60-79, ₹500/month for age 80+. States supplement with additional amounts reaching ₹1,000–₹2,500/month in many states. Covers BPL household elderly.

aids.nom: Post-Matric Scholarship — SC / ST / OBC Students
aids.description_en: Central government scholarship for scheduled caste/tribe and OBC students in post-matriculation education. Maintenance allowance: ₹1,200–₹4,500/month for SC/ST depending on course level. OBC: ₹1,000–₹3,000/month. Covers tuition fees and study materials.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs

aids.nom: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY) — Maternity Benefit
aids.description_en: Cash benefit of ₹5,000 for first live birth paid in 3 installments to compensate for wage loss during pregnancy and encourage institutional delivery. Second child: ₹6,000 for girl child. Aadhaar-linked DBT transfer to mother's bank account.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Women and Child Development

aids.nom: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana — Girl Child Savings Scheme
aids.description_en: Government-backed savings account for girls below 10 years with 8.2% annual interest (Q1 2025, highest among small savings). Account matures at 21 years. Minimum ₹250/year, maximum ₹1,50,000/year. Full tax exemption under Section 80C.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Finance / India Post / Authorised banks

aids.nom: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana — Free Foodgrain
aids.description_en: Free 5 kg wheat or rice per person per month for all 800 million National Food Security Act (NFSA) beneficiaries. Extended through December 2028. Distributed via 5.4 lakh Public Distribution System (PDS) ration shops across India.
aids.organisme: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
